name: xweb-scripts
description: Outillage de dev — build CSS (DaisyUI/Tailwind) + vérification JS (htmx/_hyperscript). Node est un outil de dev, jamais une dépendance d'exécution de xweb (docs/theming.md#build).

scripts.verify:editable-table: uv run python scripts/render_editable_table_fixture.py && node scripts/verify-editable-table.mjs
scripts.verify:catalogue: uv run scripts/dsl2html.py catalogue.dsl && node scripts/verify-catalogue.mjs
scripts.verify:channel-dsl: uv run python scripts/render_channel_fixture.py && node scripts/verify-channel-dsl.mjs
scripts.verify:endpoint-dsl: uv run python scripts/render_endpoint_fixture.py && node scripts/verify-endpoint-dsl.mjs
scripts.verify:validators: uv run python scripts/validators_fixture.py && node scripts/verify-validators.mjs
